messages:
Asha (CS): quick heads-up — Northbridge frontdoor intake is blocked on SSO + seat mapping. They need live access by next Tue for an exec demo. Can @Ben (Eng) and @Lia (SE) weigh in? TL;DR: SAML claim for `employeeId` isn't coming through and our seat CSV doesn't match their directory.

Ben (Eng): can you paste the SAML assertion or a minimal debug log? if we can reproduce, might be a tiny mapping shim or a manual mapping step we can do server-side for the pilot.

Asha (CS): dropping the assertion excerpt below (redacted):

```
<saml:Assertion>
  <saml:AttributeStatement>
    <saml:Attribute Name="email">alice@northbridge.com</saml:Attribute>
    <saml:Attribute Name="name">Alice M</saml:Attribute>
    <!-- missing employeeId claim -->
  </saml:AttributeStatement>
</saml:Assertion>
```

Lia (SE): that matches what I saw in the IdP test console. Two options: 1) temporary manual CSV->account reconciliation (I can run a script), or 2) short-lived API token we create that skips employeeId validation for this tenant during the pilot. Which do you prefer for speed?

Asha (CS): manual reconciliation is fine for now — prefer least surface area. We also need to lock an enablement slot: customer asked for Wed or Thu afternoon PT.

Ben (Eng): manual reconciliation sounds safest. I can give Lia a runbook for the reconciliation and a small helper script. ETA: I can review and merge in ~4 hrs if no surprises.

Diego (Support): FYI I opened a support ticket with IdP contact to request `employeeId` claim be enabled — put ticket #SB-4123 in case they escalate.

Asha (CS): adding risk note: renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks. If we don't get them to demo/live, renewal becomes high-risk. We should treat this as a priority.

Ben (Eng): understood. Lia — can you run the reconciliation once I push the helper script? If you need elevated access to the tenant, Asha confirm and I'll provision a short-lived admin token.

Lia (SE): 👍 I can run it. Asha please grant the admin token and share the time window. I'll schedule the reconciliation to avoid interfering with their business hours.

Asha (CS): approved — grant up to 3 hours of elevated access. I'll message the customer to get a Wed 3pm PT enablement slot and confirm maintenance window for the reconciliation.

Sam (scheduler-bot): calendar event created: "Northbridge enablement — Wed 2024-03-06 15:00 PT" (invites sent to contact@northbridge.com, Lia (SE), Asha (CS)).

Diego (Support): capture for postmortem: please log which accounts got mapped and the reconciliation CSV in ticket SB-4123. saves future churn.

Lia (SE): will do. Also planning to run a 5-min feedback micro-survey at the end of the enablement — can we add a quick Eval link in the follow-up email? I have the short URL: https://rwd.co/eval-lite

Asha (CS): yes please include that. Also adding renewal AE to the thread: @Maya (renewals) — FYI, trying to accelerate.

Ben (Eng): one more ask — if reconciliation shows any inconsistent user mappings, I'll push a small validation fix (no DB migration) that should take <1 day. Can we set a contingency plan to cut that change behind a feature flag if needed?

Asha (CS): agreed — contingency on if manual mapping surfaces edge cases. Please tag the PR and ping me.

Lia (SE): final note: after enablement I'll collect a short list of friction points (3 bullets) and drop into the customer thread so product/eng can triage.

Asha (CS): perfect. thanks team :raised_hands: — I'll update the customer and post back once they've confirmed Wed 3pm.
